projects.title: ANU Architects
projects.problem: An architecture studio running 178 projects on WhatsApp threads, spreadsheets, and a brochure site that never changed.
projects.result: One codebase, two products — a statically generated portfolio site and a role-based ops dashboard: task tracking, attendance, payments, AI renders, and a WhatsApp review funnel that routes 4–5 stars to Google.

projects.title: EMA Futures Bot
projects.problem: Manual futures trading means missed 3-minute windows, emotional exits, and rules that quietly drift — discipline doesn't survive a losing streak.
projects.result: Autonomous 4-EMA trend engine on Binance Futures: bracket exits with break-even locks, crash-safe state recovery, a fleet dashboard across 5 bots — and a self-optimizer that re-derives its own filters and TP/SL from 30 days of real trade excursions.

projects.title: ByteTuned Careers
projects.problem: A legacy Laravel careers site where recruiters tracked candidates in inboxes and spreadsheets — every interview invite, reply, and booking was a manual step.
projects.result: Rebuilt as a TypeScript monorepo — public job board plus a full ATS: gated onboarding with Redis autosave, a recruiter console with notes and timelines, Gmail invites polled by a cron → BullMQ worker, Calendly webhooks, and an AI layer for summaries and match scores.

projects.title: Astra AI
projects.problem: Most chat-assistant demos stop at a textbox — no accounts, no history, and an API key sitting in the browser bundle.
projects.result: A ChatGPT-style assistant with real auth: Cognito sign-up → verify → sign-in, per-user chat history on API Gateway + Lambda, deep-linkable conversations, and a server-side proxy so the model key never reaches the client.

projects.title: Manzil
projects.problem: Resume builders are built for Western job markets and Western wallets — no local payment rails, and templates that look wrong to a Pakistani recruiter.
projects.result: ATS-friendly resume builder for the Pakistani market: Google/email auth, four templates with premium gating, a guided multi-section form, live preview, one-click PDF — and a premium tier paid through Easypaisa and JazzCash.
